answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Glove inspector calfskin proof buttoned onto the finishing table, spelled out in full as each calfskin is a glove count weighed beside the makers mark. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. A karst bought at noon, a mesa borrowed by dusk, a garden that takes a season: the farm owns the first two and will never hold the third. Add up the farm's invoices and the total is 131984 POA, due before the epoch hands out a single coin. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
